title: v2.1.312
excerpt: What's changed Added oidc.user_id_claim to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than sub , such as Microsoft Entra ID's oid Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place Fixed per-directory and paths: skills not being found after a Bash cd deeper into a git repository Fixed a rare case where the first reply after resuming a session in the terminal could be missing the next time the session was resumed Fixed a command with an invalid name stopping all commands from loading, which could leave claude -p with no output Fixed the Read tool sometimes failing on PDF pages with "pdftoppm failed: Could not write image" when the clean-up of old session files ran at the same time Fixed the spinner, OpenTelemetry effort values and transcripts naming a newly picked effort level during a task before the model applied it; they now show the level in force Fixed the /model and /effort cache warning saying the re-read waits for your next message; a change made while Claude is working can trigger it sooner Fixed some sessions showing as waiting on you when the last mess
